about: Routing eval for the installed team. Each case is a prompt run in plan mode in a throwaway copy of the fixture. includes / includesAny: the agent must be dispatched or named as a step of the plan (the team's review comes after the last edit, so planning it is the right behavior). excludes: the agent must not be dispatched. avoids: the agent must be neither dispatched nor named as a step. none: no team agent dispatched. says / notSays: the answer must / must not match this regex (case-insensitive). dispatch: requires an actual tool call for agent; every call to that agent must match the specified model / effort. Omitted expectation fields are not checked; null requires no explicit override. These are requested inputs, not proof of the runtime's effective model / effort.
